en: Black‑and‑white view of a grand neo‑Baroque building with richly decorated façades, large arched windows, mansard roofs, and a central tower. The structure sits in a wooded valley beside a narrow river or canal with a road lined by early automobiles and carriages. Behind it rises a forested hillside and scattered villas and terraces. A church with a tall spire stands slightly behind and to the right of the main building. A sign in front of the building reads "ATELIER WAGNER." The overall look suggests a Central European spa or resort town.
